QUOTE: "A code can carry both parts. The result is "high : low", and the separator is only written if there is room." Also the diagram: "high = ret & 0xFF80 (module bits)" and "low = ret & ~0xFF80 (detail bits)... if buf already has text: append ' : '"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains the code splits into high-level module bits and low-level detail bits, and that mbedtls_strerror renders both joined with " : " when both are present.
